name: Amir Fryszer Guttman: Life and Death of a Pop Star
original_name: אמיר פרישר גוטמן: חייו ומותו של כוכב פופ
overview: A show on the stormy life of Amir Fryszer Guttman, which were tragically cut off. The personal diaries, the rare moments, the secrets that are revealed, and conversations with the closest people - sketch his complicated character.
